name: implementation
instructions: The implementer owns edits. The reviewer stays read-only and reviews shared working-tree state. Communicate concrete file paths, test results, and blockers.

members.name: implementer
members.task: Implement the objective end-to-end: {{task}}. Run narrow validation. When the change is ready for review, send a concise change/test summary to /root/reviewer with team_followup_task.

members.name: reviewer
members.task: Review the objective and current codebase while the implementer works: {{task}}. Finish your initial turn instead of waiting in team_wait; the implementer's team_followup_task will reactivate this same session when the change is ready. Then inspect the resulting diff/tests and report concrete defects or approval to your parent.
